premise.title: The Lantern Beneath Mirror Marsh
premise.logline: An apprentice marsh guide discovers a lantern that records footsteps from a closed causeway and must decide whether to preserve or investigate the signal.
premise.immediate_objective: document the lantern response while keeping the sealed causeway inaccessible
premise.inciting_event: The sealed causeway's lantern lights although no permitted walker has crossed.
premise.central_problem: Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable?
premise.wonder_or_discovery: The sealed causeway's lantern lights although no permitted walker has crossed.
premise.stakes: Declaring the path safe could lure travelers into a collapsing marsh; concealing observations could leave a village unprepared.
constraints: Seeing reflected footsteps does not prove a person is currently on the causeway.
The guide cannot cross a sealed causeway without authorized escort.
Item inventory and lamp charges cannot reset between scenes.
One strange observation cannot settle the cause, future safety or a mentor's intent.
premise.meaningful_choice_pressure: The protagonist must choose either mark_boundary_unverified or request_escort_and_retest before the evidence window closes.
premise.mystery_or_forward_question: Whose earlier path is reflected by the lantern and is the route presently stable?
premise.local_payoff: Resolve exactly what can be reported from existing observations; leave cause, hidden motives and unverified future outcomes open.
persistent_outcomes_possible: An evidence-bounded report may be recorded only if produced and witnessed in the actual story.
Professional trust may shift only if the story earns that relationship change.
A future follow-up may become eligible but must not be treated as already authorized.
world_specific_elements: oil lanterns, footbridges, guide permits and ferries
rare lantern echoes show prior footsteps but cannot certify present safety or motive
Guides need escort authorization for a sealed causeway.
A lantern reflection records traces but cannot identify who walked recently.
